page.overview:
Who is Vega?

Vega, known as in Japan, is a video game character from the Street Fighter series, first appearing as a non-playable boss in Street Fighter II before becoming playable in its update, Street Fighter II: Champion Edition. He is a claw-wielding, narcissistic Spanish ninja obsessed with beauty who also serves as a personal bodyguard to M. Bison.

Early sketches suggest that Vega was going to resemble a medieval knight wearing a full suit of armor. This idea was scrapped, as the plot of Street Fighter was about World Warriors from different and diverse countries, not from varying time periods. There are a few remnants of this concept in Vega's final design, specifically a mask and a sharp metal claw. A similar type of weapon was used by Geki in the original Street Fighter.

In the later phases of development, a handful of concepts such as a ninja character, a Thai character and a Spanish character were left incomplete, and artist Mizuho "Katuragi" Kageyama was asked to expand on them. Initially, Claw was meant to be a Thai ninja, but Kageyama was asked at the last minute to incorporate elements of the Nameless Asura, an antagonist in the Fist of the North Star series known for his immense agility, distinct mask, bladed weapons and braided ponytail.

Vega's character archetype is very familiar in Japanese media: the , often depicted as a long-haired, effeminate, flamboyant self-lover. Certain archetypal characters are comparable to Vega, elaborated on his pop culture page.
